title: Pan-Seared Uni with Portuguese Skillet Hash
description: A simple yet elegant dish featuring seared uni on a bed of crispy portuguese skillet hash. The combination of textures and flavors is sure to impress.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of hot skillet oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped Portuguese Skillet and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the uni to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the seared uni on top of the crispy Portuguese Skillet hash.
